common: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished raster illustration of the VKChess mobile game's HOME / MODE SELECTION screen, in Russian. The attached board is an EDIT/DERIVATION TARGET and visual continuity reference: derive only its first/home screen into a NEW standalone portrait screen. Keep the dark indigo/charcoal and muted warm gold visual language, framed avatar, Montserrat body text and Alumni Sans style condensed italic headings inspired by the actual Poker Library. Do not copy other three screens. Output a flat front-facing full-screen app image, approximately 430:932 portrait proportions, no physical phone, no exterior page or captions, no watermark. Crisp readable Russian UI, consistent fine borders and gold CTA, adequate spacing. All required visible content: top VKChess wordmark, small settings icon; avatar, name "Александр", level "12", currency pawn icon with "1 240"; main heading "Выберите режим"; two selectable mode cards "Обычная" and "Рапид", with a light chess knight and dark chess knight respectively. "Обычная" is selected with restrained gold outline and a check, "Рапид" neutral. One clear full-width gold primary button "Играть". Small progress widget "Первые 10 партий дня", progress "3 / 10", small experience icon. Two secondary shortcuts "Задачи" and "Лига". Bottom navigation "Играть", "Задачи", "Лига", "Профиль", with "Играть" active. No talents, territory, consumables, purchases, stakes, rewards/formula amounts, no invented timing parameters, no promotions, no countdown. No duplicate primary buttons. This is a visual discussion concept, not a functioning app. Use the given exact copy only, avoid fake gibberish text. Preserve safe padding around all important content.

variants.name: compact
variants.direction: COMPACT COMPOSITION: The screen prioritizes the mode selector and start action. A modest elegant chess king vignette in the upper third takes at most 20 percent of the image height. Two mode cards side by side, start button directly beneath, progress and shortcuts below. Calm clear hierarchy, efficient vertical use, restrained ornament. Fully visible bottom navigation. No huge empty atmospheric background.

variants.name: illustrated
variants.direction: ILLUSTRATED COMPOSITION: A polished atmospheric chess hero vignette of ivory and dark pieces in a softly lit indigo hall occupies the upper third, with readability preserved. The mode-selection panel and gold start button are prominent in the middle; progress and two compact shortcuts below. Use the same words and same selected ordinary mode as the compact variant, making only the composition more illustrative. Keep every element readable and bottom navigation fully visible.
